# Expression data preparation for WGCNA

This report is a thin interface to `run_data_preparation()`. The same function
can be called from the Shiny application without editing this notebook.

## Environment setup

```{r}
source("set_parameters.R")
source("src/1_env_setup.R")
create_session_env(session_name)
```

## Dataset-specific metadata

The current analysis colors QC plots by the experimental cross. Keeping this
transformation outside `run_data_preparation()` makes the pipeline function
reusable with datasets that have different metadata columns.

```{r}
add_cross_metadata <- function(metadata) {
  required_columns <- c("mat.gen", "mat.ploidy", "pat.gen", "pat.ploidy")
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, colnames(metadata))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Cannot construct 'cross'; missing metadata columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  metadata$cross <- factor(paste0(
    metadata$mat.gen,
    "_",
    metadata$mat.ploidy,
    "X",
    metadata$pat.gen,
    "_",
    metadata$pat.ploidy
  ))
  metadata
}
```

## Run data preparation

```{r}
preparation_result <- run_data_preparation(
  session_dir = session_name,
  counts_file = count.matrix,
  gene_length_column = gene.length.column,
  metadata_file = metadata.filename,
  traits_file = traits.filename,
  traits_sample_id = "sample",
  traits_sep = ";",
  excluded_samples = excluded_samples,
  filtering_method = filtering_method,
  n = n,
  m = m,
  p = p,
  qc_color_column = "cross",
  metadata_transform = add_cross_metadata
)

preparation_result
```

## Quality-control preview

The clustering and PCA plots are saved in the session's `plots/` directory.

```{r}
print(preparation_result$qc$pca)
```
